contribution_types.description:
Agenda
    - Walk through TrueSight.me website to discuss onboarding for Davos community
    - Gather feedback for current onboarding
    - Discuss about onboarding of the wider community
    - Discuss about management of unissued TrueSight DAO governance tokens by Peace of Snow (Swiss Association)
    - Sharing on how hours spent during Satseva by community members are being tokenized
    - Discuss on how to translate this notion of Satseva to the wider community that is not familiar with this concept
    - Discuss on how we communicate these tokenization as points accumulated in a meta-game to audience who are not familiar with crypto-currency
    - Discuss on how we communicate DAO as a governance framework and we are basically we are a community with a set of rules we all agreed to follow



Key takeaways
    - Need internationalization on website to support different languages
    - Form should allow onboarding person to include what he/she is passionate about and want to perform Satseva in the form as
    - Need to allow visitors the ability to filter projects by geolocation
    - Spirituality is a theme that is increasingly popular as a theme for product branding… e.g. Ayurvdeic



Follow up steps
    - @⁨Anupa/diya⁩ will create a new page for onboarding prototype for Davos community as well as new form
    - @⁨Hans-Martin Heierling⁩ will provide information about the community farm initiative that is right now happening in Davos
    - @⁨Hans-Martin Heierling⁩ @⁨Anupa/diya⁩ and myself will have a follow up session on Friday to review the new onboarding flow as well as the agenda of spreading awareness of our new way of thinking about work during Davos

Time Taken: 1.5 hours

@41765663130 Thanks for the great chat. Looking into Purpose initiative : skillsharing and advisory roles within the DAO. Planning an online workshop on the possibilities to evaluate the role of the sharer. Time: 1 HR
@41765663130 spent 30 minutes today helping transport the cacao nibs samples from the event venue back to his place for storage for the evening

@41765663130 drove and dropped me off at Davos to attend events along Main Street 

Time taken by him: 30 minutes ‎<This message was edited>

@41765663130 mentioned to speak with Royston about blueprints and documentations he has on implementing off the grid stand alone cluster prototypes in extreme climate conditions

I have spoken in depth with Royston today 

Will wait for him to send them both over 

Time taken 5 minutes
‎

Had a dinner yesterday evening and breakfast this morning with @41765663130 and friends here in Davos where we discussed about @120363044028036610@g.us and @120363045796860099@g.us 

They mentioned they would be happy to make introductions when I arrived along the west coast of Africa where cacao is being cultivated. 

@120363045796860099@g.us has been particularly intriguing amongst friends as it was immediately labeled as an Elon Musk category project. 

these were the general themes surfaced during discussions about @120363045796860099@g.us

- terraforming and human colony establishment using waste materials 

- ⁠folks living in the desert are right now having a hard time figuring out how to discard the waste generated via our linear economy 

- ⁠a prototype for the above is not different from one that illustrates how circular economy can be implemented in extreme environments 

- ⁠climate change is going to create more desert and ocean surface area (_extreme environments_)

- ⁠how do we adapt to this newly formed surfaced areas on earth (_extreme environment_)

- ⁠how do we take the learnings for our terraforming activities here on earth and apply it to Mars when the colonization process starts happening

Time taken: 7 hours ‎<This message was edited>

Had a 1.5 hours FaceTime today with @41765663130 and @41799155602 where @41765663130 shared the vision for @120363045796860099@g.us and how @120363044028036610@g.us ties into it 🙂🙏 ‎<This message was edited>

Had a 1.5 hour FaceTime with @41765663130 to chat about AI and @120363044028036610@g.us cacao nibs 🙂🙏
‎

Had a one hour chat with @41765663130 where we discussed about building of vertical farms in the desert using Adobe bricks 

And cultivation of edible desert plants in these vertical farms 

Adobe bricks could be made using the clay that is naturally found in the desert

These could also be used to build more *_Shrines of Emptiness*_ dedicated to *_Do Nothing*_ out here in the desert 🙂🙏 ‎<This message was edited>
‎

Finished a 45 minute session with @41765663130 and Olaf about doing a keynote at the NG symposium happening in Bern, Switzerland on the 25th of Oct 2024

Talk about the Agroverse model and how its enabled by the 2 tier Defi model

- shipment financiers 
- ⁠token based community contributors ‎<This message was edited>
‎

Me and @41765663130 spent 10 minutes discussing where to setup our booth this upcoming WEF to serve out free flow of hot chocolate to raise awareness of the importance of supporting small scale cacao farmers in the Amazon region to restore our rainforest 🤩🙏

Had a 30 minutes discussion session with @41765663130 

Follow up
- will ship 2.5kg of cacao liquor to his address in Switzerland
 
- ⁠will ship 5kg of cacao nibs to his address in Switzerland
 
- ⁠he mentioned that @41786813052 will be happy to have us serving hot chocolate made using the cacao liquor during the week of WEF during Davos early next year at the Cultural center in Davos 

- ⁠he mentioned it might be a possibility for us to screen a movie telling the story of the cacao farms who are helping restore our Amazon rainforest at the theatre in the back of Cultural Plaza @557191035605 and @557391090002 take note of this

- ⁠Once I am done handling the shipment for Shena if I can make it on time I will be in Switzerland on the 25th Oct to give the keynote at the Symposium that Olaf 

- ⁠topic for keynote is how Ai, blockchain and cryptocurrency could be applied on projects with a focus on social impact
 
- ⁠historically as discussed with @14806488258 last year, VC model can really only fund projects that can generate 100X return on capital but there are a whole wide array of other projects that can still yield multiple X returns along with massive social impact that don’t qualify for VC funding 

- ⁠the thesis as discussed with @14806488258 is whether such projects could be allowed to make progress via a crowdsourced and crowdfunded approach enabled using blockchain, cryptocurrency and AI. <This message was edited>
Olaf, @@41765737357, @41765663130⁩ and myself spent 1 hours sharing about Agroverse project to the folks in the Symposium <This message was edited>

I spent 30 minutes with @41765663130 exploring the possibility of replacing airfreighting the portion of our supply chain with sailboat that is electric engine powered that he is right now in the midst of prototyping

Right now transport cost of shipping per kg of cacao from Brazil to USA is around USD11.5

_Hypothesis: if we shift our supply chain away from reliance on fossils fuel, transport cost per kg will become even lower_ <This message was edited>

Me and @41765663130 spent 2 hours this past week exploring the importance *_Performing Devotional Service (seva)*_ has in regard to giving people a sense of purpose in the age of AI and Robotics where people gets outperformed by machines in almost every single category of conceivable tasks.
@41765663130 spent 5 minutes sharing this new technology that is currently pioneered in Switzerland
@41765663130 spent 10 minutes introducing us to Royston 4 years back
Me and @41765663130 spent 2 hours having cacao together this morning
Me and @41765663130 spent 30 minutes discussing the next steps on how to heal the world with love 🙂🙏

narrative.text: Hans Martin Heierling serves as a current member of the Board of Governors for TrueSight DAO. His 34 contributions span projects including 20250617_beerhall, Agroverse, Recurring Tokenizations, Sun Mint, TrueSight DAO, and telegram_chatlog, with the dominant category being 100TDG for every 1 hour of human effort (26 instances), followed by 1TDG for every 1 USD of liquidity injected (7 instances). He has been active from November 15, 2023, to February 5, 2026.
